statement: Every smooth-total-space reduced normal-crossings filling of the specified S6 family has H1(D;C)=0 and h1(D,O)>=1; its centre cannot be a proper algebraic variety. For simple normal crossings at least one closed stratum fails the ddbar lemma.
notes: Existing Hodge results are applied with complete derivation. Excludes all-Kahler and all-Moishezon component models in the simple-NC category for every finite base change; unrestricted analytic fillings remain open. Independently refereed in E_B_hodge_referee.md.

statement: In every such filling the intrinsically marked map to P1 extends meromorphically and becomes holomorphic on a proper projective graph modification that is unchanged over the punctured disc.
notes: Coherent bi-anticanonical frame and the three labelled critical-value branches remove essential PGL2 gauges. No smoothness of the graph or Moishezon property of unknown vertical components is inferred. Independent referee: E_B44_referee.md.

statement: For any compact analytic normal-crossings space with ddbar normalization components, H1(C) maps onto H1(O). Thus every actual S6 semistable centre has a normalization component failing ddbar, including self-crossing centres.
depends_on: B.4.2;B.4.3;explicit branch resolutions and degree-one cocycle lifting
notes: No ddbar assumption on intersections and no algebraicity or simple-crossing assumption are required. All-Kahler and all-Moishezon normalization constructions are excluded for every finite base change. The arbitrary analytic filling remains open.
